Front: Paano kumuha ng lahat ng users?
Paano mag-filter ng users na nasa 18 pataas?
Back: Gamitin ang: SELECT * FROM users WHERE age >= 18;
Gamitin ang: INSERT INTO users (name, age) VALUES ('Juan', 25);

Front: Paano pagsamahin ang users at orders?
Back: Gamitin ang: SELECT * FROM users JOIN orders ON users.id = orders.user_id;

Front: Paano bilangin ang bilang ng users?
Back: Gamitin ang: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users;
